_comment: Actual MSP / managed-IT-services businesses for sale in Texas ONLY. Non-MSPs (hardware/VAR resellers, consumer repair shops, ISP, telecom/phone installers, franchise resales, digital-marketing, office-tech) have been removed per scope. UNVERIFIED first-pass capture from public marketplace summaries — confirm every figure against the CIM. Most headcount / customerGeography sit behind marketplace login walls and are null pending the CIM. `description`/`sector` are listing-authored (parsed for signals); `notes` is analyst commentary (never parsed). sde = Seller's Discretionary Earnings. customerGeography: local/metro/regional/statewide/multi-state/national/remote.
primarySource: BizBuySell + BizQuest — managed-IT / MSP businesses for sale in Texas
removedNonMsp: Smart Office - office/phone (office-tech, no MSP confirmation)

listings.headline: High-Margin, Customized IT Services Business (150 clients, 7 states)
listings.description: customized IT services and support for SMB and enterprise, referral-driven
listings.notes: Established 2007; 150 clients across 7 states (multi-state = remote-delivering, operable from Dallas). Team ~7: 6 full-time + 1 part-time + a CONTRACTOR acting as operations manager, plus a lead support specialist with 17 yrs tenure. 2023 rev ~$3.2M / adj EBITDA ~$1.7M (~53% margin — very high for an MSP; QoE/add-backs are the first diligence item), 2024 pace ~$1.86M. Broker: Transworld Houston (BW2304615). Price gated. RISKS: the 'GM' is a contractor (transferability), key-person concentration on the 17-yr tech, and lean staffing may be under-investment a buyer must restore. Above the Deal-1 SBA sweet spot on size.

listings.headline: IT - Mass Service Provider
listings.description: managed IT services provider, statewide client base
listings.notes: Statewide managed-services / MSP. Identical price and cash flow to the Plano offshore listing — possibly the same deal double-listed. Confirm onshore delivery, headcount, MRR %, and client concentration.

listings.headline: IT Managed Services Company (Round Rock)
listings.description: managed IT services, IT support and network services
listings.notes: Managed services; normalized EBITDA $824,911 confirmed. Asking price NOT reliably known — search surfaced conflicting figures ($3.03M and $1.76M) that could not be verified; treat as price-on-request. Round Rock = Austin metro. Right size band for Deal 1. Headcount + customer geography gated — confirm in the CIM.

listings.headline: Consulting, Cybersecurity, Managed Services & Application Dev Company
listings.description: managed services, cybersecurity, consulting, application development
listings.notes: Cybersecurity + managed services (MSSP/MSP) plus application development + consulting (BW1976102). Project/consulting/dev mix dilutes MRR quality — size the recurring vs. project split. Financials, headcount, geography, and state all gated — verify TX.

listings.headline: 707770 - IT Managed Services Company
listings.notes: Price on request. Only EBITDA disclosed (~$708K). Part of a broker's numbered multi-state series (Transworld/Sunbelt network). Just below the Deal-1 size floor — confirm exact earnings, headcount, geography, price.

listings.headline: IT Managed Services Company ($271K EBITDA)
listings.notes: Managed services; EBITDA ~$271K (BW2399924). Price, headcount, and geography gated. Location surfaced under Texas searches but not confirmed — verify state. Tuck-in size (below the Deal-1 floor).

listings.headline: Established IT Company in Corpus Christi
listings.description: owner-operated IT services, managed services, recurring revenue, long-term client relationships
listings.notes: Owner-operated, 20+ years, loyal client base with consistent recurring revenue; managed services can be delivered remotely but the business keeps a LOCAL Corpus presence (onsite needs tie it to that market). $235K / $144K SDE ~1.6x — cheap, but sub-scale (below the Deal-1 floor) and outside the target metros. Owner-dependence risk. A future tuck-in, not an initial purchase.

listings.headline: IT Company - Highly Rated & Profitable with Contracts
listings.description: IT services with long-term contracts and recurring cash flow
listings.notes: BORDERLINE: nominally an IT company with long-term contracts (MSP-model), but the listing describes ABSENTEE ownership run from a VIRTUAL OFFICE with a Ford Transit, hand tools, prospect lists, and reseller relationships (BW1593025) — that profile reads more like small onsite field-IT + reselling than a true managed-services platform. Kept because it has recurring contracts; verify managed vs. break/fix before pursuing. Financials/headcount gated.

listings.headline: Off-Shore IT Services / Managed Services
listings.description: managed IT services, offshore delivery model
listings.notes: Offshore delivery model. Identical figures to the statewide MSP listing — confirm whether distinct. Offshore labor base is the key strategic question: it clashes with the legal/professional-services vertical, the AI-L1 margin thesis, and the exit multiple.
